text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our summer training camp is in full swing,
and Curren is out training
under the
blazing heat of the sun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo hooot... Too tired...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I might be allergic to the heat... I'm
melting away...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this... If I try real hard, will
you go on a date with
me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a festival happening
tonight. If you promise that
you'll go with
me, then I think I might just be okay...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hint hint. ♥

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! ☆ I feel completely refreshed
now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Ahhhh! ♪ Hehe, we're going to a festival! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, Curren trains through the
heat... Though to be honest, it
doesn't
look like it's bothering her at all. But I
can't go back on a
promise, so...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Brooo! ♪ Look, look—they have
candied apples!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Siiis! ♪ Look, look—they have candied
apples!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Red, round, and shiny... They're sooo cute!
If only I could get one...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Thanks a bunch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mister, one candied apple, pleeease. Oh,
and do you mind if I take a
pic with your
stand, too?

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, cute missy! Go ahead—that is,
if my lil' stand is good
enough for you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thanks a bunch, mister! Let's get all
these candied apples in the
shot with me,
aaand...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap, snap!

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I like your style! Here, take another
apple—it's on the house!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! Your lovely smile is more
than payment enough, missy.
Not to
mention...

text_block_list.name: Festivalgoer A
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, isn't she, like, super cute? We should get a candied apple too!

text_block_list.name: Festivalgoer B
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'm suddenly craving one too!
Let's get a pic while we're
at it!

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Having you eat at my stand is working
wonders for bringing in the
customers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Then, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro, I got an extra candied apple for
you! Let's take a pic
together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, I got an extra candied apple for
you! Let's take a pic
together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap, snap!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#SummerFestival #SoHappy
#FestivalLove #SummerLove" Hehe, I

wonder if everyone'll like my smile? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue accompanying Curren as she
enjoys the sights and smells of
the summer
festival.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Bro! Next up, can we—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Sis! Next up, can we—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What's all this commotion about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeeeew... Boom!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh... fireworks? Sheesh, that surprised
me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're... right.

text_block_list.name: Festivalgoer A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the fireworks are so beautiful!
Gorgeous, even.

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Man, they went all out this year. Look,
another one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling fireworks light up the night sky.
Soon, nearly all the
festivalgoers are
gazing happily at the display. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I look over at Curren, her expression
is clouded over...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Big Bro, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren turns her back on the fireworks and
leads me away from the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, we arrive at a moonlit beach.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You know, I... don't like fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little taken aback. I never thought I'd
hear the perpetually
positive Curren Chan
declare that she simply "doesn't like"
something.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whenever fireworks go off, everyone looks
up at them, don't they?
Even though I'm
right down here...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They're flashy, loud, and total
scene-stealers. They snatch away all
the
attention I've worked so hard to earn.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, that frustrated me to
tears. That's why... I made a
promise to
myself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That I would become cuter than those
fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to those sparkly fireworks. I'll
shine brighter—fly higher
than any of them
can ever hope to!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll steal back the spotlight and make everyone look at me. One day, the whole world will have their eyes glued on me alone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's an ambitious dream to say the least,
but Curren's voice brims with
confidence.
After a moment of silence, she looks
straight at me with a
keen, inquiring gaze.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Bro. What do you think of me
right now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Sis. What do you think of me
right now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, the boom of the fireworks
and the faint, shimmering
moonlight both
fade into the background, leaving only her
glittering
eyes in front of mine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Thanks, Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Thanks, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Finally... I got to hear you call me cute in
your own words! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Finally... I got to hear you call me cute in
your own words! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro, you've been thinking about me a
lot lately, haven't you?
About how you
want to know and understand me better.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, you've been thinking about me a
lot lately, haven't you?
About how you
want to know and understand me better.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, hey... Why not keep thinking about
me, and only me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, you're not getting away! You're
staying with me until I'm
satisfied, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Tonight, I'll let you have me all to yourself. Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this was all just another one of
Curren's pranks. Maybe all she
wanted was
for me to tell her how cute she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But maybe, just maybe... I feel like I might
have caught a glimpse of
the real Curren
shining through today.
